parlays.name: Value 2
parlays.why: The main pick: two legs from different games, each worth its price on its own where a real price is known. Two legs keep the bookmaker's margin small (about 9% at standard prices against about 24% for six).

legs.note: pinnacle main line, blended halfway with the market
legs.story: Kings to stay close or win: the Magic are without Jalen Suggs and Tristan da Silva; the Kings are at home.

legs.note: pinnacle main line, blended halfway with the market
legs.story: Clippers to stay close or win: the Suns are without Jordan Goodwin; the Suns played last night while the Clippers come in fresher; the Suns are struggling for results.

parlays.story: Built around the Kings against a Magic side without Jalen Suggs and Tristan da Silva and the Clippers against a Suns side without Jordan Goodwin. Every leg comes from a different game, so one surprise result cannot sink two legs at once. The Clippers just snapped a seven-game losing streak, the longest of Ty Lue's career, but they are still winless on the road.

parlays.name: Core 3
parlays.why: Three legs from three different games: the strongest combination of chance and value without stacking one game.

legs.note: projection 4.1 vs season average 3.1 rebounds (blended 70/30); Winamax line, price estimated
legs.story: Andrew Wiggins over on rebounds: the Jazz have given up a lot in this area; he has tended to play well against the Jazz; a close game should keep the starters on the floor late.

parlays.story: Built around Andrew Wiggins against a defence that gives up plenty, the Kings against a Magic side without Jalen Suggs and Tristan da Silva and Derrick White's steady role. Every leg comes from a different game, so one surprise result cannot sink two legs at once.

parlays.name: The daily 6
parlays.why: The long shot: six legs, at most two per game. It pays big but lands rarely, and the bookmaker's margin compounds over six legs, so it needs every leg to carry real value. Treat it as the optional extra, not the main bet.

legs.story: Bam Adebayo over on assists: he is in the starting group and plays heavy minutes; he has been in good form lately; the Jazz have given up a lot in this area.
